## Professional Summary
Aditya Yadav is an AI/ML Engineer, Full-Stack Developer, and Founder based in India. He specializes in practical AI systems, computer vision algorithms, real-time biometric active liveness verification, deepfake detection, and production-grade full-stack web platforms. As the founder of NxtAura, he designs automated intelligent software architectures that solve complex business workflows.

## Core Specializations
- Computer Vision: Facial landmark tracking (468 points), active liveness verification (blink and head pose analysis), and deepfake classification.
- AI & Machine Learning: OpenCV, MediaPipe, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and intelligent autonomous agents.
- Full-Stack Architecture: Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, React 19, Next.js, Node.js, and high-performance WebGL (Three.js, OGL).
- Creator & Community: Technical content creator under @adityakvideos_ sharing computer vision breakdowns, AI engineering tutorials, and founder developer journeys.

## Key Projects
- SmartFaceGuard: Browser-based biometric identity platform combining real-time face detection, liveness analysis, and deepfake verification.
- Base44: Scalable multi-tenant cloud management platform with real-time analytics streaming.
- Automated Vision Pipelines: Real-time pose estimation and automated gesture classification systems.
